data.one_liner: Get image width and height by reading metadata without fully decoding the file.
data.what_it_does: Reads dimensions and orientation metadata from JPEG, GIF, PNG, WebP, and BMP images without completely decoding the file. Supports custom inputs and custom decoders.
use_when: You need to quickly check image dimensions before uploading or displaying.
You want to optimize performance by avoiding full image decoding just to read its size.
avoid_when: You need to manipulate, crop, or transform the image pixels.
You are working with formats other than JPEG, GIF, PNG, WebP, and BMP unless you write a custom decoder.
strengths: High performance because it only reads metadata/headers.
Supports multiple input sources like files, memory, and http.
Extensible through custom decoders and inputs.
weaknesses: Limited to a specific set of image formats out of the box.
Requires converting Flutter asset images to Uint8List before processing.
